summary.intent: Capture multiple E2E test improvement tasks as structured GSD todos to track deferred work without losing context from the current session.
summary.outcome: Four todos were created, STATE.md was updated, and all changes were committed to git.

repo: Only recovery.spec.ts currently deletes accounts in afterAll; the other 11 specs leave orphaned test accounts by just closing browser contexts.
The project has at least 12 E2E specs under web-e2e, with a DELETE /auth/account endpoint available for teardown.
E2E coverage gaps exist for: media preview (PDF, video, audio), AES-CTR streaming playback, and batch download/zip.

code.finding: Proposed helper wraps DELETE /auth/account and wires into all 12 specs' afterAll hooks.

workflow: The add-todo workflow supports batch creation — multiple todos can be captured in a single invocation by extracting items from conversation context.
Slug generation is handled by gsd-tools.cjs generate-slug, keeping filenames consistent with date-prefixed kebab-case format.

open_items: Add shared deleteAccount teardown helper to all 12 E2E specs' afterAll hooks.
Add media preview E2E test suite covering PDF, video, and audio.
Add AES-CTR streaming playback E2E tests.
